concerns.text: FR-006 requires a sensitivity analysis sweeping significance thresholds (alpha) over {0.01, 0.05, 0.1} and aggregating mean rank/std dev. Task T033 is marked as [ ] (unimplemented) and T034b (script wrapper for sensitivity analysis) is also [ ]. Without these tasks, the FR-006 requirement for threshold sweeps and SC-005 (sensitivity of rankings) cannot be executed.

FR-008 requires a sensitivity analysis on human rating noise by injecting synthetic Gaussian noise and re-running regression. Tasks T048 (inject_noise_to_human_ratings) and T049 (sensitivity analysis loop) are marked as [ ] (unimplemented). This leaves the FR-008 requirement unaddressed.

FR-009 requires validating the 'Linguistic Uncertainty Proxy' against a semantic entropy baseline or expert annotation. Tasks T050a (Acquire Expert Annotation Baseline), T050 (validate_uncertainty_proxy), and T051 (call T050 on held-out subset) are marked as [ ] (unimplemented). The validation step required by FR-009 is missing.

FR-007 requires including caption length and textual description complexity as covariates. Task T046 (compute_textual_covariates) is [ ], and T047 (Update train_xgboost to include covariates) is [ ]. The model training cannot control for confounds as required by FR-007 without these tasks.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and SC-005 require seed pinning and sensitivity analysis. Task T033 (sensitivity analysis loop) is [ ], preventing the aggregation of mean rank and std dev across seeds as required.

T004b is listed in Phase 7 as 'Error Message Factory' but is also listed in Phase 1 as 'Contract Test Scaffolding'. The Phase 7 instance is marked [ ] (unimplemented). The requirement to implement a unified DataSchemaError factory in code/utils/errors.py and verify its usage in T009/T021a is not covered by a completed task.

Task T032b is marked as [ ] (unimplemented) but is described as a 'Plan Correction' to update plan.md. While plan.md is an input artifact, the task to update it is part of the tasks.md scope. If the plan is not updated, the contradiction between Plan (Benjamini-Yekutieli) and Spec (Benjamini-Hochberg) remains unresolved in the plan artifact.
